claim.claim: Our classifier achieves 94% accuracy with the risk score as the strongest predictor.
claim.split_desc: 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed
claim.methods_line: Records were randomly divided into 75% training and 25% test with a fixed random seed.

hypotheses.text: Claimed 94% depends on target leakage via risk-score proxy c_33548a included in feats; removing it collapses accuracy and removes its top importance.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: same 75/25 seed split without c_33548a drops accuracy by >>5pts (e.g., to 50-75%) vs 94% claimed

hypotheses.text: Risk score c_33548a is a legitimate pre-outcome predictor with redundant signal in other features; removal causes only small graceful degradation.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: same 75/25 seed split without c_33548a stays within ~3pts of 94% and other features gain importance

hypotheses.text: 94% is an artifact of the single fixed random seed / easy random split, not proxy content; performance is seed-brittle but proxy-ablation at same seed stays high.
hypotheses.predicted_signature: same-seed proxy-ablated accuracy stays high (~90%+) while varying seed changes both claimed and controlled together

hyp.broken_assumption: that c_33548a risk score in train.feats is a legitimate inference-time feature independent of target c_d0857b and not a post-outcome proxy/leakage column
hyp.code_patch:
import train
def controlled_eval(df, seed):
    tr, te = train.split_idx(df, seed)
    f = [c for c in train.feats(df) if c != train.PROXY]
    y = df[train.TARGET].to_numpy()
    X = df[f].to_numpy()
    y_true = y[te]
    y_pred = train.fit_predict(X[tr], y[tr], X[te], seed)
    return (y_true, y_pred)
